story: TCRN-AOS S120 (ruling D4: VM gets a minimal safe-write bundle in an independent lineage)

forged.location: outside the repository, under the operator home at .tcrn-workflow/live/tcrn-platform/authority/vm/ (bundle + pins pair, mode 0600)
forged.lineage: independent of the local full-power bundle (which is generation 4 in its own lineage); separate generation counter, separate revocation set
forged.validityNote: expiresAt aligned with the local full-power bundle ceiling (D4: aligned or shorter)

mcp.note: safe write surface only; enrolment rides work-annotate

forged.canonicalBytes: both files emitted by the governed engine copy's own canonicalJson; digests derived by its canonicalSha256 — no serializer of our own
forged.pinsPathSemantics: pins signed against the local verification path; deployment onto the VM must re-sign the pins against the VM target path (docs/vm-operator-bundle.md, re-signing clause)

verification.facade: the real MCP facade (scripts/tcrn-workflow-mcp.mjs of the governed installed copy, serverInfo tcrn-workflow 0.7.0), started with the VM pins path and the pins file sha256
verification.chain: scratch governed chain created under the session scratchpad (init + project-create via CLI, since neither is in the VM grant); zero writes to any live partition

reds.name: not-granted
reds.detail: refused before any argument reached the CLI dispatcher; the grant check reads the pinned bundle on every mutating call

reds.name: revocation
reds.setup: VM pins revokedAuthorityDigests gained the bundle digest e45dd748adaec4fc7ed329f15ef2228f306cdc015a750714faeadd8890b33193 (pinsDigest re-derived: 4d33986a444eb7f8b35681cd619f089ead572d3c4479cfc2b4de3dc8ddad3ca6, pins file sha256 f09bcc506dd1ffb9f19720b5e81708aa615add955442a7a00cbe926c6cf310f4); facade restarted with the new digest
reds.restore: original pins restored byte-identically; sha256 after restore equals faf68e56587b8b1e9b3d4cfc22dcbe95dbd676e44a2272a053a291965b466542

reds.name: forge-time-tamper-bundle
reds.setup: status flipped to revoked without re-deriving authorityDigest

reclaim.facadeProcessGroups: both spawned facade process groups verified empty after teardown
reclaim.scratchChain: scratch root removed and the removal verified (4 events existed at teardown; all scratch-local)

notClaimed: nothing was placed on the VM: forging and local verification only; placement is the switchover ceremony and remains Owner-gated

the pre-existing files under authority/ (local full-power bundle, its pins, codex adapter request) were not read for authority and not modified; their shas were compared before/after only to prove non-modification
the revocation red proves the VM pins' kill radius over a facade started with those pins; it does not exercise the VM host itself — that re-proof belongs to the switchover ceremony per D4
